summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) on August 20, 2026, furnishing notice of an investor relations event rather than any corporate transaction. The company will attend the 2026 UBS Korea Summit in Seoul on August 24-25, 2026, sponsored by UBS Securities, with one-on-one and group meetings beginning 10:00 KST on August 24. Topics cover second-quarter 2026 financial results and Q&A. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; this is routine IR scheduling with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
